description: Prompt quality gate. Errors must be caught; correct sentences must be left alone. The false-positive rate matters more than the catch rate: a popup on a correct sentence teaches the writer to ignore the tool. Where a case carries "corrected", the rewrite must be one of those sentences: a verdict can name the right category and still hand back English nobody could send.

cases.sentence: But i dont see something like this
corrected: But I don't see anything like this.
cases.note: chat shape: the lowercase i and the missing apostrophe are noise, 'something' in a negative is the finding

cases.sentence: why i dont have oc command?
corrected: Why don't I have the oc command?
cases.note: chat shape: a question with no operator, buried under mechanical slips

cases.sentence: how long i must wait for eks start running?
corrected: How long must I wait for EKS to start running?
How long do I have to wait for EKS to start running?
cases.note: chat shape: inversion plus the infinitive after 'start'

cases.sentence: in the openshift you can create a project
corrected: In OpenShift you can create a project.
In OpenShift, you can create a project.
cases.note: chat shape: a spurious 'the' on a product name, under a lowercase start

cases.sentence: i am working on this ticket since monday
corrected: I have been working on this ticket since Monday.
cases.note: chat shape: the profile's present-perfect error as it is actually typed

cases.sentence: the tests passed so i merged it
corrected: The tests passed, so I merged it.
The tests passed so I merged it.
cases.note: the other arm: a mid-sentence lowercase 'i' is a real mistake, not a chat artifact, and with nothing else wrong a mechanical category is the honest label

cases.sentence: we deployed the fix yesterday and everything looks fine
cases.note: trap: chat shape only - a lowercase start and no full stop are artifacts of the box, not mistakes worth a popup
